recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, top-down photograph of a stark white room where five figures in white clothing are seated around a central table, all covered in chaotic blue and yellow paint splatters that disrupt the sterile environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Central table acting as the radial anchor for the figures
High-contrast blue splatters against a monochromatic white background
Geometric tension between the square room and the organic paint drips
Black framing borders containing the bright interior scene
coreInvariants: Black horizontal bars at top and bottom for text placement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are arranged radially around a central rectangular table, filling the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white table in the center serves as the primary anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central table and follows the paint trails outward to the figures and the room's corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the floor and walls, punctuated only by thin paint lines.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue and mustard yellow (paint splatters)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation environment contrasted with high-saturation, medium-value paint accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Thin white border lines separating image from black bars

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the late 70s/early 80s.
Provides a similar clean, modern look with slightly more humanist proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a top-down photograph of five people in white clothes sitting around a white table in a white room. The floor and table are covered in messy splatters of blue and yellow paint. The lighting is bright and clinical. Frame the image with thick black horizontal bars at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white text in a geometric sans-serif font like Futura to the top and bottom black bars. Use all caps and wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Are the paint splatters primarily blue?
Is the text centered in the black bars?
Is the room entirely white except for the paint?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures around the table
Specific shade of blue used for accents
Width of the black framing bars
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the paint looks like liquid splatters, not digital brushes.
Verify the white clothing blends into the white furniture.
Check that the black borders are solid and opaque.
Confirm the text tracking is sufficiently wide to feel 'modernist'.
recipe.reuseFormula: Bird's-eye view of [Subject] in a [Color] monochromatic room + [Contrasting Color] paint splatters + [Geometric Sans] text on black letterbox borders.
